name: Anna
overview: Anna, a prophetess from the tribe of Asher, is portrayed in Scripture as a devout widow who dedicated herself to continual worship and service in the temple after living with her husband for only seven years. Like other godly women such as Miriam and Deborah, Anna exemplifies faithful devotion and spiritual insight, waiting expectantly for the fulfillment of God's promises. Her life, alongside Simeon's, highlights the faithful anticipation of the Messiah and the work of the Holy Spirit in sustaining believers during times of waiting.
